title: vdiff-run-meta/v1
description: The facts that vary between runs over identical trees (run.meta.json): the commit ids, the vdiff version and the tool versions each extractor reported. They are kept out of the canonical files so that identical trees give identical bytes there.

vdiff_version.description: The vdiff tool version, without build metadata.

base_commit.description: The full object id of the base commit, 40 hex digits (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256).

head_commit.description: The full object id of the head commit, 40 hex digits (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256).

extractors.description: The extractors that contributed to the run, ordered by name.

ExtractorRun.description: One extractor that contributed to the run and the tool versions it reported.

tools.description: The tools the extractor ran on, ordered by tool.

ToolVersion.description: One tool and the version it reported.
